selection.criteria: status=done; artifact_kind=openapi|swagger; non-empty version; absolute HTTPS artifact URL; ISO full-date retrieved_at; public access; measured counts; in current defs scope

connectors.evidence_source: metadata docs_url; DocuSeal's provider-published OpenAPI YAML export
connectors.counting_note: Counted every HTTP operation object in DocuSeal's provider-published OpenAPI artifact: seven GET, ten POST, four PUT, and two DELETE. GET actions are reads. Every non-GET action creates a submission/template, clones/merges a template, uploads/creates a document-derived object, updates, or deletes state, so is a write. The artifact has no inbound webhook event operation.
connectors.selection_reason: selected explicitly after provider-artifact quality review; the record independently satisfies the machine-readable, versioned, public, bounded-operation evidence gate
